verdict.rationale: Anthropic's Privacy Center documents a first-party export flow: Settings > Privacy > 'Export data', then a download link arrives by email. That supports the 'export and leave' core of the story. The evidence does not say what format the export uses or whether it covers all data, and it notes the export runs only from claude.ai web or Desktop with a 24-hour link expiry. missing for 10: documented open/standard export format, confirmation that the export covers all data (conversations, projects, memory, files, API-side data), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: To export your data: Go to Settings > Privacy. Click 'Export data'. Once the export has been processed, you will receive a download link via email.
